text:
emma: FYI kicking off a staged drip for llmroute_sparse_flag in the 02:30 UTC change window. plan: 0% -> 2% -> 10% -> 30% (12m spacing). pin model v4.0.0 for exposed requests, autoswap to v3.9.9 on failure.
deploybot: scheduled job: 20240601-llmroute-171 queued for 2024-06-01T02:30:00Z. will emit step events.
noah: rollback criteria proposal: immediate drain to 0% if p95 increases > 250ms OR delta 5xx > 0.8% for 4m. also abort on quality eval fail (auto-run).
sre-bot: monitors configured: latency_p95, 5xx_rate, cpu_util, kv_cache_miss. page on sev1 if p95 > 600ms OR 5xx_rate > 2% for 3m. runbook: https://wiki/internal/rollouts/llmroute-drip
olivia: adding release notes: "llmroute_sparse_flag staged drip to validate v4.0.0 routing. soft-pin v4.0.0 during each step; automatic fallback to v3.9.9." putting draft in releases doc. please review. :memo:
emma: ops quick checklist:
```
- t+0: set llmroute_sparse_flag = 2%
- wait 12m, run smoke prompts, check p95/5xx/kv_miss/tokens/sec
- keep soft-pin v4.0.0 for 8m after each bump
- t+12m: 10% if green
- t+24m: 30% if green, then cooldown 30m
- fast-disable: `releases flag set llmroute_sparse_flag 0 --now`
```
sam: I'll run the A/B quality evals after each step and post a short summary.
deploybot: executing step1: llmroute_sparse_flag = 2% (6942000120). next bump scheduled in 12m.
noah: smoke run #1: p95 +18ms, 5xx flat, small kv miss increase +0.4%. quality evals: no drop detected. green to continue.
sre-bot: telemetry snapshot: p95=142ms (+18), 5xx=0.12%, kv_miss=1.6% (+0.4%). within gates.
emma: bumping to 10% now. calling it out before action.
deploybot: executing step2: llmroute_sparse_flag = 10% (6942000300). next bump at +12m.
olivia: updated release notes with sequence and runbook link. noted soft-pin duration. :thumbsup:
sam: quality update after step2: small skew in tokenization for edge prompts (0.6% regression). not sure if model or routing. recommend holding before 30% until we investigate for 10m.
noah: hold agreed. pausing scheduled bump. we're running targeted prompt diffs now. if regression persists, we'll fast-disable.
sre-bot: telemetry during hold: p95 stable, 5xx unchanged, but token-drop observed on 0.2% of requests. flagging as watch.
emma: thanks team. changing plan: hold at 10% for +12m while we triage quality. if quality clear, continue to 30% otherwise drain to 0% and revert pin.
deploybot: scheduled bump cancelled. will await manual resume.
olivia: note for release notes: "paused at 10% for quality triage; no service degradation observed."
emma: if we need emergency rollback, sequence is: `releases flag set llmroute_sparse_flag 0 --now` then `routes pin model v3.9.9`. ops-oncall: @noah, @emma.
noah: running deeper evals now, will post results in ~8m.
sre-bot: reminder: page to eng-oncall if any sev1 triggers. all dashboards linked in runbook.
emma: closing initial ops thread; will reopen when we resume or fully rollback. thanks for quick responses. :white_check_mark:
